QuestInfo.name: Cassandra the Sticker Collector
QuestInfo.0: There is a rumor going around that Cassandra is collecting Cygnus Stickers. Get some Cygnus Stickers and visit Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: Bring some fantastic Hawkeye Stickers and Oz Stickers to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.2: You gave a Hawkeye Sticker and an Oz Sticker to Cassandra, and received a Speedy Cygnus Knights Chariot ticket!

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k.\r\nOh, did you hear that rumor about me and stickers? Well, it's true. I just can't get enough stickers! But I'm still missing the best ones from my collection. I need a Hawkeye sticker and an Oz sticker.
0.1: Hey, hey, hold on... Is that a #bHawkeye Sticker#k? And an #bOz Sticker#k?! \nI can't believe this! You, of all people, have the stickers I want! The stickers I NEED! \nCan... Can I please have them?
0.2: Oh, um, of course, I would NEVER take something for free! \nHow about if I trade you for some other stuff I have?\nHow does that sound?

yes.0: Hooray! Okay, um, let me get some stuff to trade. \nGive me a few minutes, okay?

no.0: Really? Are you sure? Don't you want to reconsider? \nOh... Okay. Well... If you ever change your mind... Sniff...

1.0: Okay, are you ready to trade? Ooh, I have butterflies in my stomach. This is so exciting!

yes.0: Yahoo! Thank you, #b#h0##k. \nOh, my sticker collection is almost complete now. This is great! Say, have you heard of the #bSpeedy Cygnus Knights Chariot#k?
yes.1: This chariot is a much newer, better version. It's for you! Just, you know, don't tell Neinheart I gave you this. \nNow, this is a very precious gift, so take care of it. And thank you again for the stickers!

item.0: Huh? Wh-where are those stickers you had? Did you lose them?\nDarn it! Well, come back if you find them again!
